---
title: "Fine-tune set"
---

A set of graphene structures for fine-tuning an interatomic potential for strain,
rippling and curvature, and point defects: Stone–Wales defects, vacancies,
divacancies and larger vacancy clusters, and interstitial and adsorbed atoms.
The structures were generated with five foundation models, scored by a
21-member committee, and reduced to the frames where the committee disagrees
most, keeping the set structurally diverse. The set is pure carbon.

{{< include steps/_overview_status.md >}}

A second set, of [transition states](ts/index.qmd) for point-defect processes,
comes from climbing-image NEB calculations and has its own pages.

## Steps

Each step has its own page with methods, settings and results.

1. [Committee](steps/01_committee.qmd): the 21 members, the three new models of
   about 3–4.5 million parameters, the conda environments and the five generator
   models.
2. [Starting configurations](steps/02_configurations.qmd): 1,300 sheets,
   nanotubes and C60 cages, with defects, strain and curvature, each with at
   most 100 atoms.
3. [Relaxation and MD](steps/03_sampling.qmd): FIRE relaxations and Langevin MD
   at 300–2000 K with the generator models, and the filters for unphysical
   frames.
4. [Committee evaluation](steps/04_disagreement.qmd): batched energies and
   forces for every candidate frame, force and energy disagreement, and how far
   each member sits from the rest.
5. [Selection](steps/05_selection.qmd): disagreement score, diversity-weighted
   greedy selection, the stopping rule and the output file.

## Files

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `finetune_selected.extxyz` | The selected frames (the deliverable) |
| `candidate_scores.csv.gz` | Disagreement scores for every candidate frame |
| `committee.json` | Committee members, checkpoints, checksums and generators |
| `config.json` | Relaxation and MD settings |
| `configs_summary.json`, `candidates_summary.json`, `selection_summary.json` | Counts at each step |
| `work/` (ignored by git) | Starting configurations, sampled frames, candidate pool and committee predictions |

The [README](README.md) lists the commands that reproduce each step.
